submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 with a 33 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 94.072% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This represents a significant improvement over Algorithm-L2 (peak ~85% efficiency) and Algorithm-L3 (peak ~74% efficiency). The iterative topological clustering with learned calibration approach of Algorithm-L1 provides superior discrimination between signal and background. The 33 GeV threshold was determined through systematic simulation scans across the allowed 20-60 GeV range, identifying the optimal operating point. All candidate algorithms are confirmed to fit within the FPGA resource budget and optical link bandwidth constraints.
